heading_en: Offsetting of Positions in Derivative Transactions Other Than Credit Derivatives
summary_ja: クレジット・デリバティブ以外の派生商品取引のポジションの相殺要領を定める。
summary_en: Sets out how positions in derivative transactions other than credit derivatives may be offset.
paragraphs: The procedures for offsetting positions in derivative transactions other than credit derivatives shall be as set forth in the following items: (i) Opposite positions in the same product with the same issuer, coupon, currency and maturity, whether cash positions or notional positions, may be excluded from the objects of risk calculation under the simplified approach, for both specific risk and general market risk; (ii) Where a position in a futures or forward transaction and a position in the underlying asset corresponding to that transaction are opposite to each other, they may be offset. In addition, where there are two or more deliverable products for a futures or forward transaction, if the underlying asset most advantageous to the Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. making the delivery has been identified and a strong correlation is recognized between the price of that futures or forward transaction and the price of the underlying asset, the position in that futures or forward transaction and the position in the underlying asset may be offset; (iii) Long positions or short positions in derivative transactions in debt instruments, etc. may be offset where they relate to the same underlying asset, have the same notional value and are denominated in the same currency, if they satisfy the conditions prescribed in (a) through (c) below according to the category of transaction set forth in those items. In addition, positions on one side of different swap transactions may be offset with each other if they satisfy the same conditions: (a) Futures transactions: the difference in maturity is within seven days; (b) Swaps and FRAs: for the floating-rate positions, the reference rate is the same and the difference in coupon is within 15 basis points; (c) Swaps, FRAs and forward transactions: the difference in the residual maturity, etc. of the underlying transaction is within the limits prescribed below: (1) where the residual maturity, etc. of both or either is less than one month: the same day; (2) where the residual maturity, etc. of both or either is one month or more and one year or less: within seven days; (3) where the residual maturities, etc. of both exceed one year: within thirty days.
